mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article WHERE status = 'published' AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(view_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM article_log WHERE view_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(view_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
SELECT a.id, a.title, s.views, s.likes, s.comments FROM article a JOIN article_stats s ON s.article_id = a.id WHERE a.status = 'published' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.views DESC LIMIT 10
